## Substantive prompts

Paste the exact prompts that shaped the extension. Include the customized extension-selection prompt from the checkpoint and any important implementation follow-ups. Delete unused prompt blocks.

> I am creating a regression case study in R and Quarto. My project proposal details are attached. I found this limitation or opportunity: when I plot every variable as an interaction between itself, there are only upside-down crosses in the added-variable plots.
